paper_metadata.title: BlueLM-2.5-3B Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We present BlueLM-2.5-3B, a compact and unified dense Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) designed for efficient edge-device deployment, offering strong general-purpose and reasoning capabilities. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first 3B-scale MLLM to support both thinking and non-thinking modes, while also enabling explicit control over thinking token budget. BlueLM-2.5-3B is developed through diversified data curation, key data resampling, hybrid heterogeneous reinforcement learning, and a high-performance training infrastructure. Our model achieves superior multimodal capacity while preserving competitive pure-text performance with only 2.9 billion parameters. We conduct comprehensive evaluations across a broad range of multimodal and text-only benchmarks. In thinking mode, BlueLM-2.5-3B achieves comparable performance to Qwen3-4B on text-only benchmarks, and trails the larger Kimi-VL-A3B-16B by only about 5% on average across multimodal evaluations. In non-thinking mode, it outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-3B on the majority of multimodal benchmarks. Additionally, BlueLM-2.5-3B exhibits exceptional data efficiency. All of the aforementioned performance is achieved with substantially less total training data than Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen3-4B. We hope our work contributes to the advancement of high-performance, on-device MLLMs and provides meaningful insights to the research community.

extraction_data.innovation: Adaptive thinking/non-thinking switching: single model adaptively switches between thinking and non-thinking modes based on user query types or chat templates, unlike prior models that require separate architectures or manual prompting; Multi-phase training pipeline with curriculum-inspired multi-stage distillation: blends pre-training data with synthesized reasoning data to strengthen complex reasoning and contextual understanding, improving performance across general and reasoning tasks; Joint pre-training with 40% pure text: increases pure text proportion in multimodal joint pre-training to mitigate text capability degradation common in small MLLMs; Large-model distillation for text pre-training: enhances small-model accuracy (+4%) while reducing training costs.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Pure text data (6T tokens for teacher, 3T distinct tokens for 3B), multimodal data (image-text pairs, VQA, GUIAgent, SynthesisQA, LongText), STEM, programming code, general reasoning examples, synthetic data
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Joint supervised fine-tuning with thinking mode fusion, long-CoT SFT, RLHF, Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)
extraction_data.extension: Pruning and distillation from a 7B teacher model; YaRN for context extension from 4k to 32k
extraction_data.research_problem: Building powerful edge-side multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with simultaneous multimodal reasoning and general understanding capabilities.
extraction_data.application: Edge-side deployment, mobile devices, vehicles, robotics, complex inference, visual content manipulation, autonomous navigation, embodied intelligence, multimodal reasoning, GUI understanding
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Long-CoT dataset (300k STEM contest queries with validated ground truth); multimodal and text-only preference datasets for RLHF
extraction_data.hardware_description: on-premises GPU cluster of thousands of high-performance GPUs interconnected via 4x200 Gb/s InfiniBand (IB) network, adopting a fat-tree and rail-optimized topology; 10,000+ core resource pool
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: RoPE (switched to YaRN for long context)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Text pre-training with large-model distillation → MLLM pre-training (40% pure text) → reasoning-enhanced training with curriculum-inspired multi-stage distillation
extraction_data.reasoning_mode: Hybrid thinking/non-thinking with adaptive switching based on query type or chat template
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: 3.3T synthesized data for integrated image-text reasoning tasks, Synthesized reasoning data
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Reward model trained on preference data collected from open-ended QA tasks, Task-specific reward forms
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Modular decoupled architecture with vision encoder, adapter layer, and language model
extraction_data.vision_encoder: ViT architectures, SigLIP2 (so400m-patch14-384), adjusted to 378x378, integrated with AnyRes processor for dynamic resolution and tiled processing
extraction_data.benchmark_result: AIME2024: +27 points over Qwen3-4B in <8K tokens; LiveCodeBench-v1: +8 points over Qwen3-4B, +23 points over Kimi-VL-A3B in <8K tokens; MMMU: 51.3; MMBench-V1.1: 78.3; MMstar: 66.3; MM-vet: 65.1; OCRBench: 84.0; AI2D: 82.6; MIA-bench: 82.6; MathVista: 78.4; MathVision: 47.7; HallusionBench: 57.3; MMLU-pro: 66.7; GPQA-Diamond: 59.6; Math-500: 92.8; GSM8K: 95.5; BBH: 89.3; AIME24: 73.3; AIME25: 66.7; IF-Eval: 80.2; Humaneval: 94.5; LiveCodeBench-v1: 81.5; LiveCodeBench-v5: 54.2; MMMU: 47.5; MMBench-V1.1: 82.1; MMstar: 64.5; MM-vet: 66.7; OCRBench: 82.6; AI2D: 83.0; MIA-bench: 81.1; MathVista: 70.8; MathVision: 28.5; HallusionBench: 53.7
extraction_data.post_training_infrastructure: RL infrastructure with performance optimization and remote deployment of the reward model
